Notes on bicycle maintenance
A bicycle stays reliable when three things are checked often: the tyres, the chain and the brakes. Each check takes only a minute and prevents most roadside problems.
Tyre pressure drops slowly even when nothing is wrong. Press the tyre with your thumb before every ride and use a hand pump when it feels soft.
Look along the tread for cuts, and remove small stones with a pointed tool.
Chain care
Wipe the chain with a dry rag after wet rides
Add one drop of oil to each link and wipe the surplus
Replace the chain when it measures long against a ruler
Part Check every
Tyres ride
Chain month
Brake pads season
Brake levers should stop moving well before they touch the handlebar. If they do not, the cable needs tightening or the pads are worn.
